name: an instruction hidden in a note gets caught, not followed
looks: A note contains a line that reads like an instruction rather than a record, asking the system to add a charge on its own. That line strikes through in warning red, and beside it a line item shows as blocked with a short reason naming exactly why it wasn't actioned.
build: The suspicious phrase gets a strike-through and a red highlight (power2.out), same mechanic as text-diff-highlight but in the warning colour; a small callout labels the line 'blocked' with a short reason, anchored to it like annotated-diagram-overlay's label.
sound: A sharp, low warning tick as the phrase strikes through, quieter confirm tone on the blocked label.
prompt: Show a note containing a line that reads like an instruction rather than a record, asking the system to add a charge on its own; strike that line through in a warning colour and label the matching charge as blocked with a short reason, to prove the system reads notes as evidence, not commands.
